problem: The immutable English production cache was declared complete while 126 public source strings were still missing, and several regression tests still described the older provider-dependent production model.
root_cause: The restored config cache blob lagged behind the current public corpus. New AI ecosystem/homepage copy plus seven money-page strings existed outside the authoritative config cache, while older tests still asserted STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=1 and provider-fallback semantics.
prevention: The authoritative production translation corpus is config/bg-static-i18n-en.json plus versioned patches under config/bg-static-i18n-en.d.
Every new public source string must be added to the versioned cache in the same lineage as the public-copy change.
Production remains STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 with STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1 and fails closed on STATIC_I18N_CACHE_INCOMPLETE.
Provider translation remains an explicit non-default fill path, not a normal production dependency.
Regression tests must describe the cache-only production contract and must not reintroduce provider-dependent assumptions.
